model_or_population: 786 SCA3/MJD participants from five geographic origins

claim: In a four-kindred SCA6 series, two large kindreds had uniform 22- or 23-repeat alleles while onset across affected participants spanned 24 to 63 years
model_or_population: four SCA6 kindreds; two large kindreds with uniform 22- or 23-repeat alleles

claim: In two monozygotic twin pairs, one with SCA2 and one with clinically characterized episodic ataxia type 2, quantitative phenotypic discordance was observed
model_or_population: two monozygotic twin pairs; one SCA2 and one clinically characterized episodic ataxia type 2 pair

claim: In 188 symptomatic SCA3 participants from 43 Brazilian municipalities, municipality-level rural proxies were associated with approximately 1.8-year earlier residual onset
model_or_population: 188 symptomatic SCA3 participants from 109 families and 43 Brazilian municipalities

claim: In Purkinje-cell-directed conditional SCA1[82Q] transgenic mice, early mutant ATXN1 suppression reversed measured pathology and motor dysfunction
model_or_population: Purkinje-cell-directed SCA1[82Q] transgenic mice

claim: In Sca1 mice, early MLIN hyperexcitability drove modifiable Purkinje pathology

model_or_population: Sca1 mice; patient-derived GABAergic neurons for shared signature only
scope_limit: Causal intervention evidence is in mice; human data do not establish in-vivo circuit causality or clinical efficacy

claim: In purified full-length human GluD2 reconstituted in DPHPC bilayers with 10 mM D-serine, open probability was markedly higher at 37 degrees C than at 22 degrees C
model_or_population: purified full-length human GluD2 in DPHPC bilayers with 10 mM D-serine

claim: Recombinant Cbln1 can transiently improve gait in adult cbln1-null mice

scope_limit: Gait rescue does not establish replacement therapy for polyglutamine SCA or humans; synapse reformation requires the separate 2008 citation

claim: In HEK293 cells, a hypermorphic TRPC3 construct containing the moonwalker mutation and cerebellar Delta28 isoform stabilized channel opening and caused calcium-dependent death

model_or_population: HEK293 cells; C. elegans; cryo-EM; moonwalker mouse T635A corresponding to human T573A

claim: In adult mice with cerebellar AAV9-ATXN3[Q89] expression, pharmacological ROR alpha-gamma activation improved behavioural morphological and mGluR1-related abnormalities
model_or_population: adult mice with cerebellar AAV9-ATXN3[Q89] expression

model_or_population: patient iPSC-derived neurons carrying linked SNP c.987G greater than C

model_or_population: 291 SCA3 mutation carriers before and after onset and 121 healthy controls; median follow-up approximately 1.02 years

model_or_population: 40 genetically confirmed SCA6 participants with baseline SARA at least 10; 20 randomized per group

claim: In the Brazilian subgroup of a multicentre SCA3 study, rare APOE epsilon4 homozygosity was associated with approximately six-year earlier onset

claim: In mice with Bergmann-glia-specific APC loss, glial disruption caused non-cell-autonomous Purkinje degeneration

model_or_population: mature cbln1-null cerebellum
